data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
(None directly — infrastructure marker-lifecycle wiring. The .fix-bug-active marker is the gating predicate that all of dd-2/dd-3/dd-4 wiring depends on; each downstream SKILL task (5b/5c/5d) owns its respective DD. This task establishes the marker lifecycle and the per-session antipattern-ok counter they share.)

Wire the .fix-bug-active marker lifecycle into plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md: create the marker at skill activation (so the commit-msg HARD-GATE knows fix-bug is the active skill), remove it at clean skill close, and initialize a per-session counter for the '# antipattern-ok: <reason>' annotation capped at 3/session. Add .fix-bug-active to the repo-root .gitignore so the marker is never committed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0) — Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0) — Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] SKILL.md creates AND removes the .fix-bug-active marker (lifecycle, not just one half) — Verify: grep -c '.fix-bug-active' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md | awk '{exit ($1>=2)?0:1}'
- [ ] SKILL.md documents the 3/session antipattern-ok annotation cap — Verify: grep -qiE 'antipattern-ok.*(cap|3/session|3 per session)|(cap|3/session).*antipattern-ok' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md
- [ ] .fix-bug-active is gitignored — Verify: grep -qx '.fix-bug-active' .gitignore || grep -q '^\.fix-bug-active' .gitignore
- [ ] TDD exemption: unit criterion 1 — SKILL.md marker lifecycle + .gitignore are instruction-file/config changes with no executable logic; structural grep assertions are the verification. Verify: grep -q 'fix-bug-active' plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/SKILL.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Wire .fix-bug-active marker lifecycle + 3-annotation session counter + .gitignore in SKILL.md
